inspiration.observed_pattern: An UPDATE JOIN consumes a derived ROW_NUMBER window result to assign stable positions to existing rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to two tasks in one group so the regression isolates a derived partitioned ROW_NUMBER feeding an UPDATE JOIN. Identifiers, values, and application context remain independently authored.

fixture_notes: Tasks 901 and 902 share group alpha and receive positions 1 and 2 by descending priority; both sentinel display positions are overwritten by the derived window result.
determinism_notes: Task IDs, group, priorities, window ordering, and final primary-key ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE dispatch_tasks (task_id INT PRIMARY KEY, task_group VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, task_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, priority INT NOT NULL, display_position INT NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE dispatch_tasks AS target INNER JOIN (SELECT task_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY task_group ORDER BY priority DESC, task_id ASC) AS new_position FROM dispatch_tasks) AS ranked ON ranked.task_id = target.task_id SET target.display_position = ranked.new_position

checks.sql: SELECT task_id, task_group, task_label, priority, display_position FROM dispatch_tasks ORDER BY task_id
